summary:
Detail-oriented Credit Professional with 6+ years of experience in credit risk assessment,
loan underwriting, and business verification across NBFC and banking sectors. Skilled in
evaluating customer profiles, financial analysis, and field investigation. Proven ability to
mitigate risks, detect fraud, and maintain portfolio quality. Seeking opportunities in credit
analysis / banking operations, including international roles.
